# Vitality

> Vitality is a remote coach-matching service. After a short discovery call and a
> human triage, each person is matched to the right coach from a vetted pool. The
> coach builds a personalised nutrition plan and workout plan, then runs weekly
> check-ins. Everything is fully remote. Vitality operates across the Nordics and
> the EU and is a project by Arenzo.

## Key facts
- Service: remote coach-matching; nutrition plans, workout plans, weekly check-ins
- Delivery: fully remote (no in-person sessions)
- Coverage: Nordics and the European Union
- Audience: individuals, and companies arranging team performance programs
- Operator: Arenzo (Vitality is a project/brand, not a separately registered company)
- Contact: David@vitality.training
